brief.summary_1line: Bharata denies involvement in Rama’s exile, weeps before Queen Kaushalya, and curses whoever caused the banishment while proclaiming his devotion to Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata collapses at Queen Kaushalya’s feet, weeping as the pale and trembling queen embraces him in grief.
The sorrowful Queen Kaushalya, weak from separation from Rama, walks with trembling steps through the hall toward Bharata and Shatrughna.
Bharata with joined palms passionately swears curses upon whoever exiled Rama while courtiers watch in stunned silence.
